name: Automated fire detection and suppression module

source.document: User-defined G6 concept based on the vessel resource-governor challenge.
assumptions_added: G6 is a custom simulated safety-critical guest, not an official Annex B guest.
The module is modeled as one atomic guest with monitoring and suppression modes.
Total installed mass is assumed to be 500 kg.
Physical dimensions are assumed to be 2.0 x 1.0 x 1.5 m, with a 2.0 m2 footprint.
G6 is assigned the entirety of Bay 2 for this demonstration.
G6 uses chilled-water cooling, with 1 kW electrical demand producing 1 kW of heat.
Local backbone demand is assumed to be 1 Mbit/s.
Compute demands and power-line assignment are synthetic values stored in resource_profiles.json.

capability.description: Monitors simulated compartments for overheating or fire and coordinates simulated fire suppression.

components.name: Automated fire detection and suppression module

configurations.notes: Synthetic placement: reserves Bay 2 exclusively for G6. Cannot share Bay 2 with G2 or G5.

power_modes.notes: Assumed continuous demand of 2 kW. Safety-critical operation cannot be automatically shed.
Assumed suppression demand of 8 kW. Safety-critical operation cannot be automatically shed.

cooling.notes: Synthetic assumption: chilled-water demand equals electrical demand, 2 kW in monitoring and 8 kW in suppression.

data_links.notes: Assumed 1 Mbit/s local backbone demand for simulated monitoring and suppression coordination.

operational_modes.notes: Continuously monitors simulated compartments. Fire-detection logic is handled separately by the simulator.
Coordinates simulated suppression after an external fire event. No automatic fire trigger is defined by this manifest.

installation.notes: Installation crew, duration and permitted installation conditions remain unspecified.

policy_hints: G6 cannot be automatically shed because safety_critical is true.
Mission priorities cannot override safety-critical protection.
Insufficient resources must be reported rather than silently disconnecting G6.
Synthetic demands are not verified hardware specifications.
documented_unknowns: Actual mass, dimensions and electrical demands remain unverified.
Minimum and peak electrical demands are unspecified.
Installation crew, duration and permitted installation conditions are unspecified.
Actual compute requirements, bandwidth and processing latency are unspecified.
Fire-detection thresholds, automatic suppression activation, stopping and reset behavior are not defined.
Monitoring-to-suppression transitions require controller logic beyond this manifest.
notes: G6 is a custom demonstration guest.
Physical and resource assumptions must remain traceable.
The resource governor must preserve G6 safety-critical protection.
This manifest represents simulated resource demands, not a real fire-control system.
